title: kbsettings reads five layers, defaults, group, clone, kb root and user, lets a group lock a key, and explain names the layer and file that decided each one
goal: kbsettings.effective merges, later over earlier: DEFAULTS; the group file (the path group_settings names in the clone's settings.json, or KB_GROUP_SETTINGS); the clone's <WS>/settings.json (in a plugin host, the host project's .it-ops-kb/settings.json); the kb root's settings.json; the user's <WS>/_private/settings.json. Besides coordination it reads the top-level extensions, extension_paths, backlog and gate_checks objects. A group file's locked list names keys a later layer may not change: such a change raises SettingsError naming the key and the group file, exit 2. explain prints each key's source as the layer name and its file (group, clone, root, user, default).

run:
import json,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); g=d/"group.json"
w=lambda p,v: p.write_text(json.dumps(v),encoding="utf-8")
w(g,{"coordination":{"announce":{"needs_you_after_min":5}},"locked":["coordination.announce.needs_you_after_min"]})
w(d/"settings.json",{"group_settings":str(g),"coordination":{"strategy":{"working":"wait"}}})
(d/"_private").mkdir(); w(d/"_private"/"settings.json",{"coordination":{"strategy":{"working":"proceed"}}})
x=lambda k: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbsettings.py","explain",k,"--root",str(d)],capture_output=True,text=True)
r=x("strategy.working"); assert r.returncode==0 and "proceed" in r.stdout and "user" in r.stdout, (r.stdout,r.stderr)
r=x("announce.needs_you_after_min"); assert r.returncode==0 and "5" in r.stdout and "group" in r.stdout, (r.stdout,r.stderr)
w(d/"settings.json",{"group_settings":str(g),"coordination":{"announce":{"needs_you_after_min":20}}})
r=x("announce.needs_you_after_min"); assert r.returncode==2 and "locked" in r.stderr, (r.returncode,r.stderr)
